scope: Transfer the owned synthetic connection lease after actual DELETE receipt, before releasing success or rate-limit response; verify the stale worker cannot mutate replacement state or tokens
takeover_sql: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections SET refresh_lease_owner='synthetic-replacement-worker',refresh_lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 hour',revoke_retry_count=7,revoke_retry_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 hour',revoke_last_error_code='synthetic_replacement_retry',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id='worker-rest-connection' AND organization_id='org-review' AND status='revocation_pending' AND refresh_lease_owner='worker-revocation' AND refresh_lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
row_sql: SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections c WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'
fence_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('owner',refresh_lease_owner,'lease_unexpired',refresh_lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp(),'retry_count',revoke_retry_count,'retry_at_present',revoke_retry_at IS NOT NULL,'error_code',revoke_last_error_code) FROM issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections WHERE id='worker-rest-connection'
